title: NAVI AI Platform — Python Skill Runtime Schema
description: Extends OSS-27 SKILL.yaml with Python subprocess execution metadata.

SubprocessPythonTransport.description: Transport config for interfaces[].transport when type=subprocess_python.

entrypoint.description: Python file to invoke, relative to the skill's base directory.

function.description: Callable inside the entrypoint module. Must accept a single dict and return a JSON-serializable value.

VenvStrategy.description: per_skill: full isolation, high startup cost. per_category: skills sharing skill_id prefix share a venv. shared: no isolation, minimal cost.

Lifecycle.description: cold: spawn on demand, exit after result. warm: keep idle worker in pool between invocations.

IOFormat.description: Wire format for subprocess I/O. json_stdio: newline-delimited JSON over stdin/stdout. msgpack_stdio reserved.

SkillMaturity.description: prototype: fast iteration, loose deps, not for high-frequency use. stable: pinned deps, tested, production-ready. hardened: candidate for Go port.

SkillResult.description: Mandatory envelope returned by every Python skill invocation on stdout.

status.description: success: normal. error: Python exception. timeout: wall-clock exceeded. killed: OOM or SIGKILL. truncated: output capped at max_output_bytes.

output.description: Skill-defined return value. Populated on success and truncated only.

type.description: Exception class name or runner error category.

traceback.description: Python traceback. Populated in debug builds only; redacted in production.

duration_ms.description: Wall-clock execution time in milliseconds, measured by the Go runner.

PythonRuntimeSpec.description: Top-level python_runtime block in SKILL.yaml. Controls environment, lifecycle, I/O, resource limits, isolation, and maturity.

python_version.description: Minimum required Python version. Skill is skipped by the loader if not satisfied.

requirements_file.description: Path to pip requirements file, relative to skill directory. Omit if no file-based deps.

dependencies.description: Inline pip specifiers merged with requirements_file.

warm_pool_size.description: Maximum idle worker processes per category when lifecycle=warm. Ignored for cold skills.

spawn_timeout_ms.description: Maximum time allowed for process spawn and readiness before the attempt is aborted.

max_input_bytes.description: Input payload size cap in bytes. Runner rejects oversized inputs before spawn. Default: 1 MiB.

max_output_bytes.description: Output read cap in bytes. Bytes beyond this are truncated; result status becomes truncated. Default: 5 MiB.

timeout_ms.description: Wall-clock execution timeout in milliseconds. Overrides performance.timeout_ms for subprocess skills. On expiry: SIGTERM → 500ms grace → SIGKILL.

max_memory_mb.description: Soft RSS cap in MiB. Exceeded: SIGKILL. Result status becomes killed.

max_cpu_percent.description: Optional CPU throttle percentage hint. Advisory only if platform does not support cgroups or cpulimit.

network_access.description: Allow outbound network from the subprocess. Should only be true when security.sandbox.network_egress is also declared.

allow_fs_write.description: Allow subprocess writes outside its provisioned tmpdir. Rarely needed.

tmpdir_mb.description: Writable scratch space in MiB, provisioned per invocation and cleaned up after. 0 disables tmpdir.
